sessions.phase_label: Campaign outcome, relaunch planning, and indefinite hold

requirements.title: Twelve-Page Crowdfunding Sample Script
requirements.definition: Create the paid 12-page crowdfunding sample by adapting screenplay material into a professional page-and-panel comic script with appropriate dialogue, captions, visual direction, pacing, and presentation.
requirements.boundary_note: Page count, comic-script structure, pacing method, delivery timing, and permitted fidelity deviations are parameters of the same bounded sample deliverable. The later full-length script is separate because it has a distinct size, funding condition, and lifecycle.

requirements.title: Full Graphic Novel Script
requirements.definition: Create the prospective 80-85-page comic script for the first graphic novel as a separate post-crowdfunding production deliverable.
requirements.boundary_note: The page target, source-material choice, and narrative endpoint are attributes of one full-length adaptation deliverable. It remains separate from the paid sample because commencement depends on crowdfunding and it is independently deferred, reconsidered, and placed on hold.

unresolved_candidates.description: The 80-85-page target is clear, but the exact story coverage, preferred source material, and whether the volume should be self-contained or end with forward momentum remain unresolved attributes of the full-script Requirement.
The exchange may establish a standalone campaign-credit Requirement using the name Corodon Fuller, but the client does not explicitly confirm that the preferred credit will be used.
